notablePrerequisites: Triskelavus has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Triskelavus' first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Triskelavite creature token.
Rosie triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Triskelavite, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Triskelavite tokens to Ashnod's Altar, and then sacrifice them to their own abilities to deal infinite damage.
